heading: Deconstructing Base LLM Vulnerability Hallucinations in Smali Code
core_technical_idea: Visualizing how a base LLM lacks inter-procedural context when analyzing isolated Smali register loads, resulting in severe false positives on JNI bindings.
must_show: actual runtime reality involving C++ JNI shared library and Android Keystore

caption: Isolated Smali ingestion strips architectural context, forcing base LLMs to mistake benign register strings for cryptographic keys.

heading: Injecting API Call-Graph Constraints into the Vector Retrieval Pipeline
core_technical_idea: Two-phase vector retrieval combining deterministic call-graph dependency traversal with constrained vector similarity search to eliminate out-of-context retrieval drift.
composition: Top-down pipeline layout showing branching deterministic dependency resolution followed by convergence into combined vector context and LLM inference.
alt_text: Flowchart depicting the graph-constrained vector retrieval pipeline, showing target method chunking, static call graph filtering of class initializers and native registrations, combined context, and LLM triage inference.
caption: Graph-constrained retrieval enforces deterministic code dependencies over loose textual similarity.
mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    A[Target Method Chunk: processPayload()] --> B(Static Call Graph Vector Filter)
    B --> C[Class Initializer: clinit]
    B --> D[Native Registration: initializeCipher()]
    C --> E[Combined Vector Context]
    D --> E
    E --> F[LLM Triage Inference]

Call graph dictionary construction and JSON serialization
composition: Top-to-bottom pipeline flow showing line-by-line parsing leading to structured graph output.
alt_text: Architectural diagram showing the Smali parsing pipeline, from raw file input and regex matching to method extraction and call graph JSON serialization.
caption: Parsing pipeline converting unstructured Smali text into structured method nodes and resolved invocation edges.
